subject.title: [Feature]: Mobile apps: read-only workspace file browser (browse, preview, share)

question: Should OpenClaw accept a narrow read-only `agents.workspace` API and mobile Files browser now, separate from the broader full-CRUD workspace-management API?
rationale: The product gap is real and vision-aligned, but arbitrary workspace reads through Gateway/mobile clients change a security boundary and the issue is protected by the `maintainer` label.

options.title: Review the narrow read-only stack
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100738 plus the iOS/Android stacked PRs as the canonical path if their security constraints and platform proof pass review.

options.title: Defer to the broader workspace API
options.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers resolve the full workspace-management design tracked by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/61368 and related PRs.

options.title: Keep current file boundaries
options.body: Decline mobile arbitrary workspace browsing for now and preserve only the existing bootstrap-file and session-touched-file surfaces.

recommendation.title: Review the narrow read-only stack
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100738 plus the iOS/Android stacked PRs as the canonical path if their security constraints and platform proof pass review.

likelyOwner.reason: They opened the protected feature request and authored the current narrow candidate PR stack for the exact Gateway/mobile direction.
